label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Ben James leads RBC Canadian Open
items.text: Ben James leads the RBC Canadian Open at 9-under through 15 holes in Round 2, one stroke ahead of Ryan Fox, Brooks Koepka, and Sam Burns at 8-under.

items.headline: Mickelson ousted from San Diego club
items.text: Phil Mickelson was expelled from The Farms Golf Club in Rancho Santa Fe after allegations of inappropriate physical contact with a female employee; the club took decisive action following its investigation.

items.headline: Justin Thomas on Bob Does Sports
items.text: Justin Thomas appeared on Bob Does Sports discussing his PGA Championship final-round 65, sharing a slope-toggle rangefinder trick, and recounting his longest-ever club toss and a wild buddies-trip gambling story.
